text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a 3-week Developer Lab codelab series to accompany the OSS inference toolkit. Goal: tutorials + 1 benchmarking narrative + an interactive webinar to drive signups. Proposed launch window Apr 22 — May 10. Owners needed for blog, benchmark writeup, webinar, GH examples, and lead routing. Thoughts?

devon: Love it. Can we get a demo repo with runnable notebooks and a simple Node/Go example? I can wire up GH Actions to build the demo artifacts on PR merge. Also recommend a short 30-min webinar + 15-min Q&A slot.

alejandro: Product can provide a short dataset and two model configs for the benchmark (low-latency vs cost-optimized). I can own the benchmark numbers and a 1-pager. Also: let's define two message variants — "engineer-first: latency & cost" and "product-first: reliability & SLAs" — for A/B testing in email/web banners.

jess: I'll draft the blog outline and social copy. Need: hero screenshot, leaderboard chart, and a 3-step howto for the codelab. Any embargo on publishing? Prefer to align blog + webinar announcement the same day.

devon: For lead routing — marketing wants a webhook to send registrant info to HubSpot + source tags. Proposed UTM scheme: utm_source=devlab&utm_medium=marketing&utm_campaign=codelab_launch. Also add ?ref=github to demos. Can the Console team add a short registration CTA on the docs site landing? @alex from growth

maya: No embargo — but ask eng-ml for final benchmark numbers by Apr 12 so content team can iterate. Webinar target date May 2 (tentative). Owners: blog=jess, benchmark=alejandro, demos=devon, lead-routing=maya. Deadlines: first drafts Apr 15, final assets Apr 18.

alejandro: Confirming — I'll drop benchmark CSV and leaderboard chart into the marketing drive by Apr 11. Will include latency p50/p95 and cost-per-1k tokens metrics.

jess: I'll create the blog draft + short Tweet thread by Apr 15. Will include two headline variants for A/B test. Also drafting a small signup form for the webinar (need a form endpoint).

ci-bot: Build succeeded for marketing/demo-repo (branch: feature/codelab) — artifacts available at https://ci.internal/artifacts/1234

devon: I'll setup GH Actions to publish demo artifacts to the CDN and add ?ref=github. I'll also add a simple script to generate the leaderboard chart from the CSV. 

maya: OK — weekly check-ins on Wednesdays at 11am PST starting Apr 3. I'll create a calendar invite. If no objections, I'll lock dates and update the launch brief.

jess: ACK, thanks — will post draft links here when ready. :rocket:

devon: Ack. I'll ping infra for the webinar capacity and a short runbook for live demo fallbacks.

maya: Great, thanks everyone. Closing action items: jess (blog), alejandro (benchmark), devon (demos + automation), maya (lead routing + calendar).
